description: Query a DNS record for a domain against several major public resolvers (Google, Cloudflare, Quad9, OpenDNS) in parallel and compare the answers. Flags mismatches, which usually mean propagation is still in progress after a DNS change.

domain.description: Bare domain to query, e.g. example.com

recordType.description: Record type: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, or CNAME (default A)

name: dns_propagation_check
